article.story: POUGHKEEPSIE, N.Y. -- — Elijah Lewis scored 17 points as Marist beat Fairfield 82-67 on Saturday. Lewis shot 5 of 11 from the field and 6 for 6 from the line for the Red Foxes (12-5, 6-2 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Parby Kabamba added 15 points while shooting 5 for 7, including 3 for 3 from beyond the arc while they also had five rebounds. Justin Menard shot 3 of 6 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line to finish with 12 points. The Stags (11-8, 3-5) were led by Braden Sparks, who recorded 16 points and two steals. Fairfield got 12 points from Tony Williams. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
